claims.claim_text: Indexed Bertus Harry Wabeke is probably the same rare-name World War II veteran profiled by the Foreign Service Journal in 1954.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional biography uses the exact three-part name, identifies him as a World War II veteran and gives a coherent postwar State Department chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable from the exceptionally distinctive exact full name and compatible World War II service; the reviewed source does not state OSS service or the indexed identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The biography is postwar identity context and does not establish his immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: No education, authorship or later State Department work is presented as a pre-OSS employer.

claims.claim_text: Indexed John E Wachsmuth is a probable match to the John E. Wachsmuth listed as a 1943 University of Minnesota ROTC graduate.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional program uses the exact name and places him in a compatible wartime Coast Artillery Corps Reserve pathway.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable from exact full name and compatible wartime military context; the program does not reproduce the indexed identifier or name OSS.
claims.temporal_assessment: The program is dated 12 June 1943; the exact OSS-entry date remains unknown.
claims.match_notes: Box 810 is required before upgrading the identity to high confidence or classifying commissioned status.

claims.claim_text: A University of Minnesota program lists John E. Wachsmuth among its 1943 ROTC graduates under Coast Artillery Corps Reserve.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The printed Department of Military Science and Tactics section places his exact name beneath the Coast Artillery Corps Reserve heading.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable identity from exact name and compatible military context; no protected-identifier bridge was available.
claims.temporal_assessment: Dated wartime affiliation; its sequence relative to OSS is not established, so it is not marked immediate.
claims.match_notes: The university is recorded as a student/ROTC affiliation and is excluded from employer analytics.
